assertion.statement: CEL expressions in the Telemetry API must use standard Envoy attributes (filter_state.downstream_peer, filter_state.upstream_peer, xds.node, fully qualified wasm attributes) instead of the custom Wasm extended attributes.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: Exposure depends on CEL expression contents in Telemetry resources; no predicate can match expression text in a field without a named field path in the evidence.; consequence: Evidence says expressions must use new attributes but does not state what fails if they are not updated.
